headline: Direct conversions jumped 3.6x with flat paid spend and AI-sourced self-reports doubled, so the lift is untracked AI-driven demand and no paid channel should be credited or scaled; LinkedIn cut 33%.

moves.reason: 13-wk CPA ~$115-130 and ROAS ~1.5 (last 7d $115 CPA, 1.49 ROAS) vs Google $10 and Meta $67. Attribution models agree it is weakest (implied CPA $74-132 under all five; share 3-6%). Cut 33% is cheap to reverse; stay above zero as only 3.2-5.8% credit means value is low but not proven nil.

tests.hypothesis: Google's 65% last-touch credit (vs 43% first-touch) is inflated by branded searches from buyers persuaded elsewhere (AI assistants, newsletter); true incremental share is lower than the reported $10.37 CPA implies.
tests.design: Geo split holdout for 4 weeks: pause branded search in ~20% of matched regions, keep non-brand running everywhere. Measure total conversions (paid + direct + organic) per region vs control, plus self-reported 'Google' share. Pre-register: if total conversions in held-out regions fall less than ~half of the Google-attributed conversions, treat branded as largely non-incremental and trim it.

tests.hypothesis: The direct surge (5.7 to 20.7/day; 33 to 152 weekly) comes from AI-assistant recommendations, not paid media.
tests.design: Add 'ChatGPT/AI assistant' as a tracked landing-page source: UTM-tag or referral-capture AI traffic, add a post-purchase question with AI answers split by assistant, and monitor weekly for 6 weeks whether direct conversions track the AI answer share (currently ~37-41% combined) while paid spend stays flat. No budget change on paid channels in response.

flag_verdicts.reason: Direct rose 5.7 to 20.7/day (weekly 33 to 152) with paid spend at 1.00x. Self-reported AI answers (AI assistant + ChatGPT) rose from ~16% in early Aug to ~41% in the latest week, while 'Instagram/Facebook ad' fell from 20% to 9.5%. Pattern fits AI-driven demand, not paid. Action: no paid scale-up, recommend tracking/test.

flags.message: Direct conversions grew 3.6x (5.7 to 20.7/day) while paid spend moved 1.00x. Self-reported AI answers went from 18% to 37%. Something untracked is driving buyers.

label: synthetic data
